SELECT 
  AVG(pair_net_fee) as avg_pair_net_fee,
  AVG(difference) as avg_difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    mktnote,
    pair_avg_net_fee,
    pair_avg_net_fee - overall_avg as difference
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      orders.mktnote,
      AVG(fees.feerate - fees.rebrate) as pair_avg_net_fee,
      (SELECT AVG(fees.feerate - fees.rebrate) 
       FROM fees JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault) as overall_avg
    FROM fees 
    JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault
    GROUP BY orders.mktnote
  )
  WHERE pair_avg_net_fee > overall_avg
)
